CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_ConceptoFacturable_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@CategoriaConcepto_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @ConceptoFacturableFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		ConceptoFacturable_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @ConceptoFacturableFilter (ConceptoFacturable_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ConceptoFacturable].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @ConceptoFacturableFilter (ConceptoFacturable_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ConceptoFacturable].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable]
		WHERE
			 [ConceptoFacturable].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([ConceptoFacturable].[CategoriaConcepto_Id] = @CategoriaConcepto_Id) OR (@CategoriaConcepto_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Id],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Concepto],				
		[CategoriaConcepto].[Nombre] AS [Categoria],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Unidad],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[PrecioUnitario],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[ClaveSAT],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[ClaveUnidadSAT],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Activo],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[DesactivadoPor],		
		[ConceptoFacturable].[FechaCreacion],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[CreadoPor],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[FechaModificacion],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @ConceptoFacturableFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable] 
			ON [ConceptoFacturable].[Id] = filter.[ConceptoFacturable_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[CategoriaConcepto]
		ON [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[CategoriaConcepto_Id] = [dbo].[CategoriaConcepto].[Id] 

 
END
